changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Record each review practice's effective feedback mode when its first observation is admitted, so standing skips observations sealed in Off (ADR 0118).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review_practice ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_practice_sealed_feedback_mode CHECK(sealed_feedback_mode IS NULL OR sealed_feedback_mode IN ('OFF','APPROVE_FIRST','AUTOMATIC'));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE review_practice DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_practice_sealed_feedback_mode;
